title: Severe allergic reaction
summary: Swelling of the tongue or throat, difficulty breathing or other signs of a severe reaction after a possible exposure. Anaphylaxis is possible when the presentation is compatible. Show the mission's authorized card when one exists. Informational support only: not a diagnosis or a treatment decision. There are no clinical personnel on board: the steps are first aid and monitoring; treatment depends on mission procedures.

notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: If there is an epinephrine (adrenaline) auto-injector in the medical kit, use it immediately.
Call for emergency help now using the mission's means (ship alarm, crew, mission control if the link is up). Do not wait to see if it improves.

immediate.mission_procedure: Mission authorized severe allergic reaction procedure

limited.text: Limited allergic symptoms: watch your breathing and throat.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: If throat or tongue swelling or difficulty breathing appears, use the auto-injector if there is one and treat it as an emergency.

missing_guidance: The card's sources do not give steps for mild allergic symptoms (for example, antihistamines): it depends on the mission procedure.

candidates.label: Anaphylaxis
candidates.minimum_evidence: Throat or breathing involvement, with possible exposure or hives to consider it compatible.
